perennials/4c083a1:
The third projection: the sheet laid flat and the record standing on it, in
the round. Behind the Model toggle, three.js draws her paper as the ground,
her ink and her washed photo rendered into its texture, and every placed
plant standing at the height our data gives it, in the shape of its
recorded layer. She orbits and zooms; she never goes under the lawn.

Nothing here is a third vocabulary. A plant with no height in our data is a
flat mark on the ground, never a body; figures are the layer's archetype at
the record's height, ringed sepia at the base when the measurement is hers;
bloom colour is the only saturated thing in the scene, and a bloom the
record is silent on wears the calendar's hatch. The year scrubber and "ask
the yard" perform here exactly as on the paper, and a tap selects into the
same panel a drag stays the camera's.

The sheet never claimed a scale and the ground does not start now: the line
under the model says so, and the one scale claim made is the corner post,
as tall as the tallest plant and labelled with its metres. Heights are true
to one another; the ground is her drawing.

three.js rides in a lazy route chunk, 138KB gzipped, that the service
worker precaches: the guide's own bundle is unchanged at 97KB, the first
paint pays nothing, and the model still raises with no signal. No WebGL is
a fact about the phone, not a bug to hide; the model says it plainly and
points back at the sheet and the elevation.

The coverage line also stops claiming a remainder it does not have: "the
rest hold the ground unmeasured" now prints only when there is a rest,
which is the small cousin of the absence-dressed-as-fact bug.

noodles/4c3253a:
The dry mix has to carry the weight the sends used to, and it has to land
on a phone AND on the big Bluetooth speakers this gets played through, so
the target is translation, not a tune for either. Three moves. Saturation
up (0.08 to 0.14, wet .32 to .42) for harmonic body in the 150-400 Hz
band a phone can move. Glue softened (4:1 to 3:1) into a bus glue that
moves the mix as one and leaves crest for the kick. And a low shelf, +2 dB
at 100 Hz, placed BEFORE the saturation on purpose: the drive turns that
low end into 120/180/240 Hz harmonics, so a small speaker implies the
bass it can't reproduce while a big rig gets the real fundamental. Master
input trimmed -3 to -2.5 to hold loudness after going dry.

Calibrate receipts vs the wet/old chain: master combos -6.8..-7.9 up to
-5.5..-6.5 RMS, spread held at ~1 dB, peaks pinned at -0.2 (the ceiling,
no clipping). A sub-heavy-to-bright probe lands normal combos at ~3 dB
sub-dominance (rms minus >80 Hz body) with only 808+sub content running
bass-forward by design. WAV export runs the same graph, so exports
translate identically. Smoke passes.
